response_text: In July 2026, about 2.67 million Albertans aged 15 and over were employed — roughly 2.2 million full-time and 467,000 part-time — out of a labour force of about 2.87 million, leaving roughly 202,000 people unemployed for a 7.0% unemployment rate. About 69.2% of the province's working-age population was in the labour force and 64.3% was employed, with all figures seasonally adjusted and carrying small margins of error (for example, ±0.4 points on the unemployment rate).
